rules.governing: The lesser pressure in any one table controls the allowable pressure on the door assembly (sheet 1 note **).
rules.separate_framing: Storefront / curtain wall framing around the door is under a separate approval; the lesser allowable pressure of the door and the framing controls the overall assembly. (sheet 4)
rules.water: Not approved where water infiltration resistance is required unless: (a) non-habitable areas designed to accept water; (b) protected by canopy/overhang with OH ratio >= 1.0; or (c) installed in IR-501 with head jamb weather seal (A1 or A5), sill & sill dam (D2), meeting stile covers (E1) for pairs, 2-point lock part 40/42 at inactive, 3-point lock part 39/41 at active, gear or butt hinges part 36/37. Positive pressure on a water-rated door may not exceed +80 psf (sheet 4).
notes: Units with 3 hinges are limited to 70 psf and to a maximum height of 90"; units with 4 hinges are limited to 90 psf (sheet 2 legend notes 3-4).
Mid-rail (sheet 6 section C/6) shall not be used for doors with design pressure over +/-70 psf; section B/6 sill dam only with water-rated doors (sheet 6 notes).

Section B/8 meeting stile covers only with water-rated IR-501 doors; B/8 applies to all locks except Corbin Russwin and Von Duprin panic devices; D/8 (keyed removable mullion) applies with Corbin Russwin and Von Duprin panic device only (sheet 8 notes).
Corner construction per sheet 1 (frame head corners, sill corners, door panel corners, mid-rail ends).
One installation anchor at each anchor location shown unless otherwise stated.
Install anchors within +/-1.000" of the depicted location and spacing (not cumulative).
Shim with load-bearing high-density plastic shims where the gap is 1/16" or more; max shim stack 3/8".
Embedment and edge distance exclude wall finishes (stucco, foam, brick veneer, siding).
Anchors and hardware corrosion resistant or coated.
Optional 1x wood buck at masonry/concrete if min. embedment and edge distance are still met in the host substrate.
Hollow / grout-filled block: no anchors in mortar joints; edge distance from free edge of block or mortar joint.
Install per anchor manufacturer's instructions; not in substrates weaker than the manufacturer's minimum.
